tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// wāgādh+yāyot+palakaṇ+ṭhikanāmadurgatiparishodhanastan+t+rādākhyatas+yapretās+thishodhanasāts+tshausādhanas+yabidhebidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bstan pa'i gshin po'i rus sbyong sāts+tsha sgrub pa'i cho ga'i ngag 'don ut+pal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// phul byung byin rlabs thugs rje'i bsil zer gyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung gdung phrogs nas// bde legs ku mud 'dab ma stong phye ba'i// bla ma thams cad rig pa'i zla bas skyongs// thar pa'i cha mthun bsgom bzlas lhur bgyis pas// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs 'phrog khyed la mi bsngags te// srid gsum sgrib pa zad par za mchog tu// rgyal kun gsung gi gsang ba las 'phos phyir// de tshul 'khrul bral gzhung na ches gsal yang*// sbyangs stobs mig dkyus ma bsrings de srid du// cho ga'i ltad mo ji bzhin ma mthong bar// legs bshad nam mkha'i nor bus snang bar byed// 'dir bsnyen pa sngon du song bas kun rig la brtan nas tshe 'das kyi rus sbyongs sāts+tsha sgrub pa'i cho ga la gsum ste/ sngon du rus sbyong bya ba/ dngos gzhi sāts+tsha sgrub pa/ mjug phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po rus sbyong la ro sreg gi cho gas pur sbyangs legs par grub nas me mnal ba na/ rus bu'i rtsar phyin te rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes mang du brjod cing lag pa bsnol te se gol brdabs la rus bu bsdu'o// rus sbyong la mchod pa nyer spyod dang*/ cha gsum gtor ma dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ bum pa bcud ldan tshul bzhin du bcas la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs nas/ thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang zhes pa'i bar gyi bdag bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas sngon du song nas/ mdun gyi bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi skabs ltar lha so bdun skad cig gis bskyed bzlas spyi ltar las/ gtso bo bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ sbyong ba'i sngags zhes pa ni/ kun rig gi lha thams cad kyi sngags yin pas/

rtsa rig la ngos bzung ste/ grangs ni 'bum phrag gcig rang ngam sgrub grogs dang bcas pas 'gro nges par bzla/ mthar lha so bdun gyi sngags rnams kyang lan gsum dang khrus sngags bzla ba dang mchod bstod zhu ba sogs dkyus ltar bya'o// de nas sngar bsdus pa'i rus bu rnams mdun du snod kyi nang du man 'ji'am shing gi khri'u lta bu'i steng du bzhag la/ sngar rtsa rig bzlas pa'i bum chu thogs te/ rus bu'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a dkar po/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya chil gyis babs pas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par bsams la/ rtsa rig dang sbyong rgyal gyi sngags bzla zhing bkru/ mthar kun rig gi lha thams cad kyi sngags kyang tshar gcig gam gsum gang rung brjod kyin rus pa chus bran zhing bkru'o// don gsal du oṃ badz+ra pra marda nā pra marda nā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzla bas kyang bkru ba'ang bshad/ spro na/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// zhes sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi tshigs bcad rtsa rig spel ba dang*/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// zhes sogs dug sbyong gi tshigs bcad rtsa rig spel te bkru/ gang la ser sna sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dril bu gsil zhing rus bu la me tog 'thor ba bcas grub par bya/ yang deng sang rus pa rten byas nas kun rig cho ga lho sgo dang bcas pa byed na shin tu legs zhes mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas gsungs so// gang ltar yang cha gsum btang*/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ sogs nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba bsngo ba smon lam bar bya'o// de nas rus pa shin tu zhib par btags nas dri bzang 'o ma sogs dang bsres nas khams sogs sa bzang po'i 'jim pa brdzis nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ 'jim pa'i gong bur byas pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/

o na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig tshar gcig brjod cing bkod/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs nas sngags phreng la thim/ sngags phreng 'od du zhu nas 'jim pa la thim/ 'jim pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi rin po che'i phung por gyur par bsams la rtsa rig bzlas mthar/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ sāts+tsha'i nang gzungs 'jug rgyur rtsa rig gi swā hā'i gong du/ tshe dus las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru bcug pa mang du bris nas dri bzang gis byugs pa 'go nas bsgril/ de nyid mgo gzhug ma log par nang du bcug pa'i sāts+tsha gcig nas lnga'am/ brgya rtsa brgyad nas 'bum dang bye ba'i bar gang 'grub btab ste/ de'ang sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga don gsal du blta gsungs pa ltar na/ 'debs pa'i sngags so so yod pa'i gzhung de nyid dam kho bos sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga logs su bris pa zhig kyang yod mod/ skabs 'dir rtsa rig kho na bzlas te btab pas lag len bde zhing chog par sems so// sāts+tsha thebs pa na rtsi tshon legs par gsol nas stegs mtho bar 'bru sil mar bkram pa'i steng du bzhugs su gsol ba rnams ni rus sbyong dang sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi sāts+tsha sgrub pa la gsum ste/ rab tu gnas pa/ sgrub pa dngos/ de la bkur stir bya ba'o// dang po ni/ 'dir rab gnas dang sgrub pa gcig tu 'khrul par mi bya bar/ sāts+tsha sgrub pa'i sngon du sgrub rten la rab tu gnas pa mdor bsdus 'gro dgos/ de'i sngon du'ang rten gsar pa yin pas sbyong khrus sngon du song na bzang bas kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas 'bring por bum pa nyung mthar/

rnam rgyal dang las bum khrus bum ste gsum du bshad pa khrus sngags so sor bsags na dgos la/ khrus sngags a bhi ṣe ka ta tsam las bsags mi thub pa'i dbang du byas nas khrus bum las bum du bsdus pas rung bar sems te/ don gsal du rab gnas bsdus pa'i skabs su bum pa gcig gis chog par bshad pa ltar/ paṇa chen thar rtse pas tshe dpag med la brten pa'i rab gnas mdor bsdus su'ang las bum gcig pu sgrub par bshad pa'i phyir ro// des na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis dang nyer spyod tsam bsham/ dngos gzhi la/ mchod pa rnams yak+ṣas bsangs nas/ thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang*// zhes pa'i bar gong ltar nyams su blangs nas/ bum pa gnyis bsang sbyangs spyi ltar bskyed la/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar ro// las thams cad pa'i bum par k+ṣaṃ las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po rab tu khros pa/ phyag gnyis kyis zhal gyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar mche ba 'dzin pa rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang rdo rje gnod sbyin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can sogs tshigs bcad gsum sngags dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dang mchod pa phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha sogs kyis dgug bstim dang*/ oṃ bhṛ ta sogs kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/

oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ sogs lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbang bskur ro// de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// sogs dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang bcas pas bstod/ gzungs thag blangs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba sogs nas rnam rgyal la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ zhes dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes pa brgya rtsa re dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs khrus sngags nyer gcig tsam bzlas te/ mchod bstod byas te yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyi mthar pad kor byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥgis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces brjod/ gal te khrus bum yod cing rgyas pa la mos pas/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa khrus bum gyi steng du bzhag la/ las bum gyi chus gtor la bsang sbyangs nas/ rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes pa'i bar brjod pa ni rab gnas kyi dkyus ltar bya'o zhes brjod/ de nas sbyong ba la/ gtor ma chab kyis bran te rten la bskor ba dang bstun/ oṃ sarba bigh+lān sogs lan gsum dang*/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig ces zhi bas sbyang*/ ting lo chang bus bskor zhing*/ sum+bha ni sogs lan gsum dang*/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sogs nas/ gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan sogs brjod la zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs nas phyir dor/ khro bo spyan drangs nas mchod bstod bya/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlab kyis/ deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rang rang gi gnas su song shig gal te mi 'gro na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro zhes brjod la/ gu gul gyis bdug cing yungs kar gyis brab/ sum bha ni dang badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs brjod/ yang 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs lan gnyis bya ba ni drag po'i sbyang ba'o// til sbyong gi slad du/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib rnams snying ga nas yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas 'thon/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim par bsams la/ lag len ltar bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā zhes lan gsum gyis mer bsreg cing chur dor/ rten bkru ba'i thog mar/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i sku ring bsrel dang ldan pa rab gnas can gyi gzugs brnyan me long du 'char bar byas la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs tshigs bcad bzhi sngags dang bcas pas mchog khrus sku phyi ba dang bcas byas/ khrus chu de bum par blugs la/ rten gsar pa bkru ba ni/ khrus bum logs su bsgrubs pa yod na khrus rgyas pa kun rig gi rab gnas 'bring po ltar bya/ med na las bum gyi chus/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// zhes sogs nas sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du tshul khrims/

bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab rnams sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ chu bo drug gi sogs nas/ dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes dang*/ spro na/ gang la ser sna rnam chags sogs kyang brjod la/ slar yang ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang*/ de dag sku la sngags dang bcas pas bkru zhing sku phyi'o// de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ las bum gyi chus sāts+tsha rnams la gtor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sāts+tsha rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las seṅge btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i chos sku'i mchod rten tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i bum pa rnams kyi nang du dbus su seṅge/ shar du glang po che/ lhor rta/ nub tu rma bya/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam gzhag lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon mnyam gzhag nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur zhes dang*/ sku gzugs yod na/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bskyed/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃḥ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'am/ rigs lnga dang rdo rje sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing sogs rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ mchod de dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes lan mang du brjod cing so so la thim par bsam/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lnga la rigs lnga so so dang sku gzugs kyi rten rnams la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med ces sogs rigs lnga'i bstod pa gang shes dang*/ lha sku yod na/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che zhes sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas rdo rje thogs te lha rnams kyi spyan 'byed pa'i tshul byas la/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ne swā hā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa thob ste sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/

spro na/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas nas/ sku brnyan yod na/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang zhes brjod/ mchod rten lha dang bcas pa rnams 'od du zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ ces pa 'di dkyus su 'og tu 'byung yang 'dir brjod pa bde'o// ye dhar+m+mā mang du bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog gtor te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sogs nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ ye dharmā brjod cing me tog gtor ba de lta bu lan gsum gyi bar du byas mthar/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la/ mchod rten la/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan stengs su// sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yi// sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// chos sku'i rang bzhin can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang lha sku yod na so so'i sgos bstod ci shes byas la/ bkra shis kyi phyir dril gsil me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te/ ston mchog dam pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa dang bcas pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa mdor bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa sāts+tsha sgrub pa la/ rten gyi mdun du nyer spyod rgyas bsdus ci 'byor pa dang*/ cha gsum rigs drug yi dwags dang bcas pa'i gtor ma bsham mo// dngos gzhi la rang nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas pas stan bde bar 'khod de/ nyin grangs 'gar byed na/ nyi ma phyi ma rnams su/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes sogs mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/

thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang*// zhes pa'i bar nyams su blangs nas gzod sāts+tsha sgrub pa la 'jug pa yin yang*/ nyin dang po 'dir bdag bskyed rab gnas kyi gong du song bas thus/ rten bskyed pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten yangs shing rgya che ba sāts+tsha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa'i nang du dbus su seṅge'i khri sogs nas lha so bdun skad cig gis bskyed la/ ye shes pa spyan drang ba nas/ oṃ kar+m+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥzhes pas dbang bskur ba'i bar bum bskyed skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya/ de nas lha rnams la dmigs te rtsa rig kho na bzla ste/ dmigs pa ni/ mchod rten rnams kyi bum pa re re'i nang du kun rig rtsa ba'i lha sum cu so bdun tshang ba re bzhugs par yang yang gsal gdab cing*/ rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i zhal nas rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas pas/ lha thams cad la dmigs yul gyis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang las sgrib thams cad sbyong du gsol snyam pas thugs rgyud bskul bas/ lha de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer spro ba dang bsdu ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba'i phrin las mdzad par bsams la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs sngags bzla'o// sngags don ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di lta ste/ sbyong zhing*/ sbyong ma/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par sbyong dag rnam par dag las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa'i gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'i don to// thun bsdu ba na/ mthar mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa sogs kyis 'dod don gsol gdab byas la/

mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa sogs mchod pa nyer lnga dang*/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs sgeg sogs brgyad/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra sogs nas/ rin chen bdun dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs 'dod yon lngas mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag sogs nas phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la'o zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed kyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis mchod pa dang*/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag sogs kyi bstod pa'ang bum bskyed ltar bya/ cha gsum btang la/ mchod rten lha dang bcas pa zhu ba las sāts+tsha'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur zhes brjod cing bsam mo// de nas mchod pa kha gsos la byin rlabs byas te oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs gong ltar mchod/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan stengs su sogs mchod rten gyi bstod pa ci shes pas bstod do// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bsgrub ste/ sngags kyi grangs ni rgyud las/ sngags dang phyag rgyas btab nas kyang*// 'bum phrag gnyis kyi bar du bzlas// zhes grangs nges pa can du bstan pa ltar nyis 'bum du bzla zhing*/ rgyas pa na mchod rten 'bar ba la sogs pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du ste/ rgyud las/ ci ste mtshan ma de dag ni// sdig can blo yis ma mthong na// 'bum gyi phrag ni brgya stong ngam// ji srid mtshan ma byung bar du// de bzhin gshegs pa mchod nas ni// mnyam par bzhag pas bzlas par bya// de yi mthar ni mkhas pas kyang*// mtshan gcig thog thag mi nyal bzlas// zhes dang*/ gzhan phan 'od zer las/ mchod rten byas pa la mchod cing*/ nyis 'bum bzlas pas kyang ma grub ste/ grub pa'i rtags ma mthong na/ 'bum phrag brgya stong gi bar du bzlas shing mchod la/ mjug tu mtshan thog thag mi nyal bar rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas na rtags mthong ste 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong gi bar du bsgrubs nas mjug tu mtshan gcig thog thag mi nyal bar rtsa ba'i rig pa bzla ba sogs 'dir yang bya bar bshad do// ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni ras bris sgrub pa'i skabs su bstan pas rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o// bdag bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba/

oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ sogs nas ha ra ha ra pra ṇān hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'i bar brjod pas bsrung*/ ston mchog dam pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa'i rgyas gdab bo// gsum pa bkur stir bya ba'i tshul ni/ de ltar cho ga rnam par dag pas tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i sāts+tsha sogs ni gang zag mchog dman gang yin kyang mchod rten sogs kyi nang du 'jug tu rung zhing skabs su bab pa khang bu brtsegs pa bzhengs te 'jug par bya'o// 'on kyang grong pa'i mi nag pho mo sogs kyi rus pa'i sāts+tsha ni gong du bshad pa'i cho ga de dag gis tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa mchod rten sogs kyi rten la bcug kyang cher mi 'gal mod/ 'jig rten pa'i smod pa spang ba'i phyir ri mthon po'i rtse'am/ brag skyibs sogs 'gom yug mi 'ong ba'i sa dang*/ chu bor spyan 'dren pa nyid skabs su bab ste/ de'i tshul yang blun po 'ga' zhig gis brag phug sogs su sāts+tsha rnams gya tshoms su spungs nas 'jog ste de mi rung*/ thams cad mgo mjug ma log par legs par bsgrig go /chu klung du spyan 'dren na'ang sa rdo blugs pa ltar mi bya bar/ mgo mjug ma log par re re nas chu'i khar bzhag sems kyis rnam snang gi rdul phra rab tu gyur nas klu rnams kyis rgya mtshor spyan drangs par bsam mo// yang na phyis su chu 'bab par 'gyur bar btab nas bzhag kyang rung zhes gong ma rnams gsungs so// gsum pa mjug phan yon bstan pa ni/ de ltar byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyud las/ de ni nges par dmyal gnas na// de byas pas ni grol bar 'gyur// yi dwags byol song sdug bsngal las// grol te lha yi gnas su skye// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phan yon la bsams nas tshul 'di la 'bad par rigs so// sāts+tsha ma thebs pa'am/

lhag ma'am/ sbyin sreg byas pa'i thal ba rus pas rdo sogs ni rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor na phan yon chen po 'byung bar bshad do// 'dir smras pa/ bcom ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud chen gyis// mngon par bsngags pa'i rus sbyong sāts+tshar brten// sdig sbyong cho ga'i pak+ṣu sa skya pa'i// dad sgrol mkhyen pa'i ma dros mtsho las babs// 'on te de tshul gcig tu ma rdzogs par// gsar bus gzu lum spyod pa bzlog slad du// 'dab stong bcud kyi ro mngar rkang drug bus// gcig tu bsdus bzhin ngag 'don snying por bsdebs// 'di bgyis rnam dkar legs byas khams gsum gyi// 'gro tshogs mtha' dag sdug bsngal kun 'byung bcas// 'gog lam chos kyi bdud rtsi rtag 'jo ba'i// smra dbang chos kyi rgyal po thob phyir bsngo// zhes ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bstan pa'i gshin po'i rus sbyong sāts+tsha sgrub pa'i cho ga'i ngag 'don ut+pal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'bri klung ma'i rgyun chen dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs dbon stod dgon gyi dbu mdzad ye shes lhun grub pa dang tshul khrims chos dar bzung gis bskul ngor/ rje btsun rin po che dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gzhan phan rnam gnyis dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pa dang mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa rnams kyi gsung rab rnams la zhib par gtugs te/ lag tu blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis dpal 'byor gling gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi 'don 'grigs la nye bar mkho ba'i gzhan phan zur rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgyal bas lung bstan shes bya'i gnas kun la// chos mig dri med brnyes nas rgyal bstan la// mkhas pa'i las byas e waṃ par btud de// des gsungs cho ga'i 'dod 'grigs 'dir spel lo// de'ang kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi steng nas/

mang po'i tshogs bsgrigs su 'don pa'i tshe/ gzhung nyid tshig sdud ches pas skabs 'ga' rer/ yul phyogs tha dad du slob dpon so so'i ngag khrid tha dad du gyes pa'i tshig don 'brel chags mi chags sna tshogs pas bslad par mchis pa rnams gzhung don mthun par nyams su len tshul gyi zur rgyan cung zad dgod bya 'di lta ste/ bdag bskyed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dus kyi sngags bzlas kyi 'od zer spro bsdu'i ngag 'don ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs tshar gcig brjod/ sngags phreng bkod pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar byas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer slar 'dus snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge la thim zhes brjod/ bsnyen pa rgyas pa dang 'bral ba'i tshe/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ sarba bita sarba a wa ra ṇa sogs nas badz+ra ā we sha ya aḥzhes pa'i bar dang slar yang rtsa rig tshar lnga brjod la/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar sngags phreng bkod pa/ de rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar byas/ lha so so'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer slar 'dus lha so so'i thugs ka'i chos kyi yi ge la thim zhes brjod pas thus la/ de'i dmigs pa ni/ sngon byung ston pas sems can rnams kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol bar byas nas/ bde ba so so la bkod pa de'i thar pa'i 'dra 'bag dang mthun par bya ste/ rang nyid rdor sems su gsal ba'i thugs kar sngags phreng bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros pa smin mtshams nas 'thon/ dmigs yul gyis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig sgrib dang bcas pa sbyangs/

rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la dgod ces pa'i don yin la/ lha yongs rdzogs kyi skabs su ni/ gtso bo nas 'jig rten pa'i rnam pa can gyi bar/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rtsa rig tshar re g.yas skor du bkod pa'i nang du lha so so'i rang sngags rnams bkod/ rang sngags so sor med pa rnams la ni/ slar yang nang du rtsa rig lhag po re dang bcas bkod pa la dmigs te/ sngags phreng de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ni 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal spyi dang bye brag tu ngan song gi sdug bsngal ni dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i 'gro ba gsum gyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar byas/ lha so so'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer slar 'dus lha so so'i thugs kar thim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ de'ang lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dus gcig tu bsgrags nas/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi skus don mdzad pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma rnams kyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma rnams kyis ni byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma'i go 'phang dang*/ nyan thos rang rgyal rnams kyis ni nyan rang gi go 'phang dang*/ khro bo rnams kyis ni ye shes kyi khro bo'i go 'phang dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul gyis ni 'jig rten skyong ba de dang de'i go 'phang du bzhag ces pa'i don yin la/ mthar gyis ni thams cad kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang la bzhag dgos pa ni thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par nyid do// cha gsum gtor ma'i skabs kyi bgegs dgug pa la ni/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs nas/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad lha'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig

oṃ ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa tsam las gzhan mi mdzad de/ don la 'dir bgegs kyi rigs su gtogs pa thams cad bkug nas gtor ma sbyin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// lho sgo'i phyir bzlog skabs/ tshe 'das kyi rten bskyed pa ni/ byang bu sogs rten gang yin bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar yi ge nṛ yongs su gyur pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa lta bu chos pa'i che ba brjod dgos pa dang*/ mi chen lta bu'i zhes dgos pa'i rigs la ni/ sku tshe'i dus las 'das pa che ge mo zhes pa tsam dang*/ phal pa yin na tshe dus las 'das pa'am tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur ces brjod/ 'dir 'ga' zhig gis bde bar gshegs pa dang zhi bar gshegs pa zhes brjod pa ni cung zad 'thad par ma mngon te/ de dag la ni sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal sbyang du yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon dang tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i nṛ las 'od 'phros/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes khams gsum gang na gnas pa nas bkug par bsams la/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs nas rnam par snang mdzad lha'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug srid pa bar do gang na gnas kyang*/ skad cig gis rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ sho dha ne sogs kyis kyang bkug nas bstim/ oṃ sarba bita sarba pā paṃ sogs kyis sdig pa dral ba'i sngags dang bcas pas dral/ oṃ

rgyud las/ snying ga lkog ma kha phyogs su// sarba bita kyis byin gyis brlabs zhes gsungs pa ltar mas yar gsum du'am/ gzhan phan rnam gnyis las/ spyi bo la sogs par gtugs te zhes sogs khong las gsal kha ma byung yang*/ da lta'i phyag len du spyi bo nas yas mar la gsum tsam mdzad srol snang*/ sarba bita badz+ra sogs phyag rgya dang bcas te/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med pa zhig tu gyur par bsam/ las kyi rdo rjes gtor mas rten la g.yas phyogs su lan gsum gsum du bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān sogs gsum gyis zhi ba'i sbyong ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor zhing las kyi rdo rjes ting lo chang bus bskor zhing oṃ sum+bha ni sogs gsum gyis zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyang ba dang*/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo gson gyi dus sogs nas song zhig gi bar brjod/ khro bo spyan drangs nas mchod bstod/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i mthar che ge mo gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba sogs nas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bya'o// oṃ suṃ bha ni dang oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha'i sngags gnyis bcas pas brab ste/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis drag po'i sbyang ba rnams song nas/ tshe las 'das pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying ga nas yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas sna sgor thon te mdun gyi til la thim/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ sogs dang til bzung ba'i lag pa g.yas pas g.yas dang*/ g.yon pas g.yon dang*/ gnyis kas g.yas su bskor zhing me dang chur dor ba'i til sbyang byas la/ sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i bye ma'am yungs kar gyis brab cing oṃ sarba pā paṃ sogs nas sarba satwa nāñtsa swā hā'i bar sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod mthar/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag par gyur cig ces pa'i bar brjod/

de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gzugs brnyan me long la 'char du bcug la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis mchog khrus sku phyi bcas byas pa'i chu bum par blugs la/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin sogs sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su rtsa rig brjod cing bkrus pa'i mthar/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs dag nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs sh+lau ka re re'i mtshams su rtsa rig brjod cing bkrus mthar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas byin gyis brlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad bcom nas dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig ces dang*/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin sogs la'ang sh+lau ka re re'i mtshams su rtsa rig brjod cing bkrus mthar/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i nyon mongs dang rnam rtog rgyu dang bcas pa 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad du bral bar gyur cig ces brjod/ shis par brjod kyin bkru ba ni/ rten la me tog 'thor zhing*/ las kyi rdo rjes rten la bum chus 'thor ba'i tshul dang bcas te/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa zhes sogs kyi mthar/ tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal zhing bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod/ skabs 'dir bar do chos bshad byed pa yod na/ des rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par bshad do// de nas skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi tshogs sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos te/

de dag gi spyan sngar sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ lus dbul ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas te tshig 'di dag gi rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs gdangs dang bcas te brjod/ de'ang tshe 'das de nyid kyis slob dpon gyi ngag gi rjes zlos byed pa'i tshul du 'don pa'i dbang du byas na/ tshe 'das zhes mi brjod par/ de'i tshab tu bdag cag dang bdag ni zhes skabs su gang babs sbyar te/ gzhan phan 'od zer las/ bu la sogs pa'i lag tu byang bu 'dzin pas phyag byed du bcug la/ yid kyis tshe 'das des phyag byed kyin/ tshigs bcad rnams ngag tu zlos pas skyabs su 'gro bar bsam zhing rang gis brjod/ gal te gshin po des rjes zlos mi byed par/ slob dpon rang gis tshe 'das de nyid rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'bul ba'i dbang du byas nas 'don pa na/ dkyus ltar tshe 'das zhes brjod dgos/ de gnyis gang yin brda sprod byed pa'i slob dpon des tshig 'di dag gi rjes zlos mdzod ces pa brjod mi brjod bshad pa'i ngag mnyan pa gtso che ba'o// de nas dbang bskur mi byed par phyir bzlog tsam byed na/ rten de nyid/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa sogs nas/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a zhes pa'i bar gyis bdag bskyed kyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed la/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar mchod bstod dang 'dod yon 'bul ba dang*/ byang bu yod na bsreg pa dang*/ lam sbyong bstan rnams byas la/ bzang spyod la sogs pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa'i rgyas gdab bo// dbang bskur byed na sta gon mjug pa dang bcas pa/ dngos gzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa'i dbang rnams bskur nas/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/

deng nas brtsams te yan chad gson po'i skabs ltar byas la/ de rnams kyis ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob pas/ rang bzhin gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ de ltar dbang bskur bas khyed rang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa de mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas/ nye bar spyod pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod de rdo rje sems dpa' sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod do// 'dod yon gyi rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos mchod gnas lha la bdag 'bul gyis// bzhes shig bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes pas gzugs dang de bzhin du sgra dri ro reg bya rnams kyang de'i rigs 'gre sbyar te/ spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes pa'i rjes thogs su thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig kho na brjod pas chog 'ga' zhig gis rnam shes rten bskyed lha la 'di 'bul zhes sogs dang tshe las 'das pa'i mig gi yul du gzugs phun sum tshogs pa zhes sogs 'brel med sna tshogs brjod pa rnams la ni snying po med do// de nas byang bu bsreg pa'i brda sprod byed na/ slar yang 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs pa de spyi gtsug nas 'thon te mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas par bsams/ de nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros bral du shes par byas te/ de'i ngang nas 'khrul ngor snang ba'i tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyi ngo bo tha mal pa'i gzugs kyi rnam pa can nam ming byang gi rnam pa bsreg cing sbyang du rung ba dpe bud shing dang chos mtshungs su gnas pa de nyid/

slob dpon gyis chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba sbyong byed me dang chos mtshungs su yod pa des/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gzugs byang de nyid bsregs shing sbyangs pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes kyi snang ba chen po gcig tu 'bar bar mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing sogs kyi mthar rtsa rig zlos shing bsregs nas bsreg bya sreg byed sreg pa po ste 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i lta ba'i rgyas gdab bo// de nas dkon mchog rin chen sogs lam sbyang ba dang*/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas lam bstan pas/ rnam shes rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba de nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhabs drung du thogs pa med par yud kyis gshegs/ der sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i thugs rje dang byin gyis brlabs kyis skad cig yud tsam la rdzus skyes kyi skye ba blangs nas mchod pa 'bul ba sogs byas par bsams la/ smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab bo// de nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug sdud/ oṃ bud+dha sogs dang rjes chog rnams dkyus ltar bya'o// smras pa/ rang gzhan don gyi phan bde sgrub pa la// bsgrigs legs tshig gi phreng ba la ltos te// chu skyes ro bcud sdud pa'i bung bas kyang*// 'phur lding gdangs snyan bsgyur ba mi byed dam// gcig tu rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhal lung la// ngag sgros phal pas bslad na mi rung snyam// 'don 'grigs nyung zad bgyis pa'i dge bas kyang*// rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi 'don 'grigs la nye bar mkho ba'i gzhan phan zur rgyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/

'bri klung ma'i rgyun chen dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs dbon stod dgon gyi dbu mdzad ye shes lhun grub pa dang tshul khrims chos dar rnam pa gnyis kyis gsung gi bskul ngo ma bzlog tsam du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas dpal 'byor gling gi rgyal khab du myur bar bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
